question: Should provider route resolution expose provider-owned configuration parameters as a stable plugin SDK input, or should the loopback proxy value be delivered through a narrower existing OpenAI-owned seam?
rationale: This is an additive cross-boundary plugin API decision; code review can establish that the implementation is plausible, but only maintainers can choose the permanent public extension contract.

options.title: Adopt the generic route-context seam
options.body: Accept `configuredProviderParams` as the provider-owned, secret-free input for concrete route construction and keep the OpenAI implementation plus contract tests.

options.title: Use a narrower OpenAI handoff
options.body: Keep the core route context unchanged and redesign the OpenAI resolver so only the validated proxy setting reaches its owner-specific policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic route-context seam
recommendation.body: Accept `configuredProviderParams` as the provider-owned, secret-free input for concrete route construction and keep the OpenAI implementation plus contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the immediately preceding loopback proxy feature and are the strongest available history signal for this provider boundary.
